name: boc_get_series
description:
Observations of any Bank of Canada Valet series, by series name or shorthand indicator, from the Bank of Canada Valet API (no API key).
Returns: series_name, label, description, dimension, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first.
Inputs: series_name (Valet name such as FXUSDCAD, V39079 for the policy rate, AVG.INTWO for CORRA or BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD; wins over indicator) or indicator (usd_cad, eur_cad, gbp_cad, jpy_cad, cny_cad, policy_rate, overnight_rate, prime_rate, bond_2y/5y/10y/30y (30y is the long-term benchmark), cpi, core_cpi (CPI-trim)); one is needed; start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD; either or both); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; the last N observations, used only when no date is given).
Find names and shorthands with boc_search_series; for one value use boc_get_latest; topic tools: boc_get_exchange_rate, boc_get_interest_rate, boc_get_bond_yield.
Example: {"series_name": "FXUSDCAD", "start_date": "2024-01-01", "end_date": "2024-03-31"}

series_name.description: Bank of Canada series name (e.g., 'FXUSDCAD', 'V39079'). Use this for direct series access.

indicator.description: Common indicator shorthand name for convenience

recent_periods.description: Number of most recent observations to retrieve (1-100). Used when start_date and end_date are not specified.

description.description: Detailed description of the data series

dimension.description: Dimensional metadata about the series (units, frequency, etc.)

examples.description: Get policy rate for date range
